notes:
Refers specifically to a painting created with oil-based paints. The formal term for what is colloquially called ⟦{油絵|あぶらえ}→油絵：07076_aburae⟧. Oil painting as a technique was introduced to Japan during the Meiji period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {油彩画|ゆさいが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to paint an oil painting
- {油彩画|ゆさいが}⟦{展|てん}→〜展：28468_ten⟧: oil painting exhibition
- {小品|しょうひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{油彩画|ゆさいが}: a small oil painting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{油絵|あぶらえ}→油絵：07076_aburae⟧: oil painting — the everyday, colloquial equivalent
- ⟦{水彩画|すいさいが}→水彩画：07077_suisaiga⟧: watercolor painting — uses water-soluble paints; lighter and more transparent than oil
- ⟦{油彩|ゆさい}→油彩：27155_yusai⟧: oil painting (technique/medium) — refers to the method rather than the finished work
